Data.Review360.平均绝对偏差计算规则适中说明: When the rating tendency falls within the "Moderate" range, the "Mean Absolute Deviation" is further referenced: if the Mean Absolute Deviation > {step}, it indicates that the evaluator rates some individuals strictly and others leniently, which averages out to the Moderate range. In this case, the system will append a note after the "Moderate" label to help viewers make comprehensive judgments in conjunction with specific evaluations.
Data.Review360.平均绝对偏差计算说明: On this basis, the system also calculates the "Mean Absolute Deviation" — taking the absolute values of the aforementioned differences, summing them, and averaging the result to measure the degree of variation in scores an evaluator assigns to different evaluatees.
Data.Review360.平均绝对偏差说明: Additionally, some evaluators may have an rating tendency that falls within the "Moderate" range, but they actually rate some individuals strictly and others leniently, which averages out to the "Moderate" range. To identify this situation, the system supplements the rating tendency with a "Mean Absolute Deviation" calculation, providing another perspective for judging reference value.

Data.Review360.评估尺度介绍: When users view 360° reviews, they usually want to know the "rating tendency" of reviewers, that is, whether they tend to be more lenient or strict with rating. To help users better understand the ratings, the system calculates the "rating tendency" of the reviewer - the larger the value, the more "lenient" the reviewer is likely to be with rating.
Data.Review360.评估尺度计算介绍一: Theoretically, "rating tendency" should be defined based on the difference between the reviewer's rating and the reviewee's "actual performance". As "actual performance" is an intangible concept, we use the median of ratings given by all 360° reviewers to represent the reviewee's "actual performance".

Data.ReviewRule.如何配置等级量化值详细内容:
We recommend you enter a number between 0 and 10. The greater the number, the better the performance. Please properly set the quantizers to distinguish the levels. Levels with similar rankings should have similar quantizers and levels with distinctively different rankings should have distinctively different quantizers. 

Example: 
There are 7 levels as follows: 
D: Unqualified
C: Significantly below expectation
B-: Slightly below expectation
B: Meeting expectation
B+: Slightly above expectation
A: Significantly above expectation
S: Excellent

B-, B+, and B levels are close to each other; S and A are far better than B+; and C and D are far worse than B-. As a result, we can set their quantizers as follows.
D: 1
C: 2
B-: 4.5
B: 5
B+: 5.5
A: 8
S: 10

Data.review-dimension.for_example_small_c_gav:
Example: A company has 5 performance levels, namely A – E matching score from 5 to 1 respectively. Z gave X and Y a review rating of A and B respectively.

X received three 360° review ratings, which were A, C, and C (median: C). Y received 4 review ratings, which were B, C, C, and D (median: C).

Then Z's rating tendency = [(A-C) + (B-C)] / 2 = [(5-3) + (4-3)] / 2 = 1.5
Data.review-dimension.specify_a_key_evaluatio: Specify a key review item as the rating tendency for the 360° review
Data.review-dimension.specify_key_evaluation_: Please select the evaluation item(s) for calculating the rating tendency. If multiple evaluation items are selected, the rating tendency for each item will be displayed separately.
Data.review-dimension.the_evaluation_scale_is: A reviewer's rating tendency is based on the gaps between their rating on a specific reviewee and the median of all the ratings on this reviewee.
Data.review-dimension.when_users_check_360_ev: Rating tendency measures a reviewer's strictness during the review.
Data.review-dimension.例子一: Example: A company has 5 performance levels, namely A – E, matching scores from 5 to 1 respectively. John rated David as A, and Mary as B. David received 3 360° review ratings: A, C, and C (median: C). Mary received 4 review ratings: B, C, C, and D (median: C). Then John's rating tendency = [(A - C) + (B - C)] / 2 = [(5 - 3) + (4 - 3)] / 2 = 1.5.
Data.review-dimension.例子二: Example 2: A company has a performance score range of 0 – 100. John gave David 70 points, and Mary 95 points. David received 3 360° review ratings: 60, 70, and 80. Mary received 4 review ratings: 10, 30, 40, and 95. Then John's rating tendency = [(70 - 70) + (95 - 35)] / 2 = 30.
